title: Business Account Not Showing on Chase App? Complete Triage & Linking Guide [2026]
content:
You operate a small business, freelance LLC, or commercial enterprise alongside your personal banking. But when you open the Chase Mobile App on your phone to check a client deposit, transfer operational funds, or pay vendors, **your business checking account, merchant services dashboard, or Chase Ink Business credit card is completely absent from the screen**.

Instead, you see only your personal checking, savings, or personal credit card tiles. 

Did Chase freeze your commercial entity without warning? Did an automated fraud filter quarantine your Tax ID?

In over 95% of reported incidents, business accounts go missing not because of account closure, but because of **login credential segregation, mobile dashboard visibility preferences, or multi-user entitlement permission desynchronizations**.

In this guide, we walk through the universal basic troubleshooting first-aid steps, break down the strict architectural separation between personal SSN and business EIN profiles, and provide the exact instructions to display all your accounts seamlessly under one unified dashboard.

---

## 1. Basic Troubleshooting First Aid (Do These First)

Before initiating complex administrative consolidations or calling business banking support, execute these five fundamental diagnostics to rule out transient mobile client glitches:

| First-Aid Step | Action to Perform | Expected Diagnostic Outcome |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Pull-to-Refresh Gesture** | Drag your finger down on the main dashboard until the loading spinner rotates | Forces the mobile app to invalidate its local UI cache and pull fresh ledger balances from the server. |
| **Kill and Relaunch App** | Swipe up from the bottom of your screen (iOS/Android) and swipe the Chase app away | Terminates orphaned background session processes that may have timed out during handshake. |
| **Toggle Airplane Mode** | Switch Airplane Mode ON for 15 seconds, then OFF | Flushes stale carrier DNS cache and establishes a clean connection to Chase’s mobile API gateways. |
| **Verify Multi-Profile Carousel** | Check the top of your dashboard for a horizontal account switcher tab | On newer versions of the Chase app, personal and business accounts are partitioned into separate swipeable tabs. |
| **Check Chase Server Health** | Visit Downdetector or Chase’s service status page via mobile browser | Confirms whether Chase Commercial Banking APIs are undergoing scheduled Sunday maintenance. |

If basic triage does not restore your business account tile, the issue stems from account architecture or role configuration.

---

## 2. Root Cause 1: You Logged In with Personal Credentials

The single most frequent reason a business account does not appear on the Chase mobile app is logging in with a **Personal User ID**.

```
[User Authenticates on Mobile App]
                │
                ▼
        [Credential Check]
         /              \
        ▼                ▼
[Personal User ID]    [Business User ID]
        │                     │
        ▼                     ▼
Displays Consumer     Displays Commercial +
Accounts Only (SSN)   Linked Personal Accounts
```

Chase maintains strict regulatory separation between individual consumer banking profiles governed under Social Security Numbers (SSN) and commercial enterprise accounts established under Employer Identification Numbers (EIN).

- **Your Personal Login:** Can only display consumer accounts (Sapphire, Freedom, Slate, personal checking). Federal compliance regulations strictly prohibit commercial accounts from being managed under an individual retail profile.
- **Your Business Login:** Governed by commercial agreements. Chase allows you to link your personal accounts **into** your business profile, but will **never** allow business accounts to live inside a personal login.

### How to Verify Which ID You Used
1. Sign out of the Chase Mobile App.
2. Examine your stored password manager entries (Apple Keychain, 1Password, Google Password Manager).
3. Do you have two distinct usernames (e.g., `jsmith_personal` vs. `jsmith_business`)?
4. Manually type your **Business User ID and Password**. Once authenticated, your commercial checking and Ink cards should render immediately.

---

## 3. Root Cause 2: Account Is Toggled to 'Hidden' in Preferences

The Chase mobile app features an account display manager designed for users who want to conceal sensitive balances when opening the app in public spaces. If an account was accidentally marked as "Hidden," it continues to function for deposits and debits, but is excluded from the dashboard.

### How to Unhide Your Business Account:
1. Open the Chase Mobile App and log in.
2. Tap the **Profile Icon (Silhouette)** in the top right corner of the screen.
3. Select **Settings** (the gear icon) > **Account Preferences**.
4. Tap **Show or Hide Accounts**.
5. Scroll through your account list. Look for your business checking, savings, or Ink credit card.
6. If the toggle switch next to the account is set to **Hide**, tap it to toggle back to **Show**.
7. Return to the main dashboard and perform a downward pull-to-refresh. Your business tile will reappear immediately.

---

## 4. Root Cause 3: Dual-Profile Consolidation via Single Sign-On (SSO)

If you have both a personal Chase account and a business Chase account, managing two separate usernames and passwords across mobile devices is inefficient and frequently causes session authentication collisions.

To permanently view all accounts under a single login, you must execute a **Single Sign-On (SSO) Profile Link**.

> [!CAUTION]
> **Directionality Is Vital:** You **cannot** link a business account into a personal profile. You must always link your **Personal accounts INTO your Business profile**.

### Step-by-Step Linking Instructions:
1. Open a desktop web browser (or mobile browser in Desktop Mode) and navigate to `https://www.chase.com/business`.
2. Sign in using your **Business User ID and Password**.
3. In the top navigation bar, click the **Profile / Settings** icon.
4. Under Account Management, click **Manage Linked Accounts** > **Link Personal Accounts**.
5. The system will prompt you to authenticate your identity by entering your **Personal Chase User ID and Password**.
6. Complete the two-factor authentication (2FA) verification code.
7. Confirm the account mapping. Chase’s core database will instantly bind your personal accounts to your master business umbrella.
8. **Future Logins:** From this point forward, discard your personal username. Log into the Chase Mobile App exclusively using your **Business User ID**. Both your business LLC entities and your personal checking/credit cards will display together in clean, organized sections.

---

## 5. Root Cause 4: Multi-User / Authorized Signer Role Entitlements

If you are an Authorized Signer, Chief Financial Officer (CFO), or employee on a company Chase business checking account (rather than the primary legal owner), the account may vanish if the Primary Administrator modified organizational permissions.

Under **Chase Business Online Access Manager (BOAM)**:
- Primary Administrators possess unilateral control to assign or revoke viewing permissions for individual accounts.
- If the administrator updated user entitlement groups or refreshed company signatory mandates, non-owner users can lose mobile visibility until their permissions are re-certified.
- **Resolution:** Contact your company’s Primary Account Administrator. Request that they log into Chase Business Online on desktop, navigate to **Account Services** > **Access & Security Manager**, select your user profile, and verify that the checkbox for **"View Account & Balance Details"** is active for that specific account number.

---

## 6. Edge Case: Dedicated Phone Escalation

If your accounts are linked, visibility toggles are enabled, and you are logged into your master Business ID, but the business account remains completely missing, your account profile may be undergoing a **Know Your Customer (KYC) / Beneficial Ownership Re-certification**.

Federal regulations require banks to periodically re-verify Corporate Beneficial Ownership filings. If verification notices sent via mail or email went unanswered, Chase temporarily suspends digital dashboard visibility.

Do not dial retail personal customer service. Contact the dedicated commercial integration division:

- **Chase Business Direct Technical Support:** 1-877-242-7372
- **Direct IVR Shortcut:** Enter your business Tax ID (EIN), then press `0#` to bypass the automated assistant.
- **What to Request:** *"I am calling because my commercial checking account ending in [Last 4 Digits] is not surfacing on my master Single Sign-On profile. Please verify if there is an active Beneficial Ownership hold or profile desync on my EIN."*

---

## Frequently Asked Questions

### Will linking my personal accounts expose my finances to other business partners?
No. Access controls are strictly isolated by credential tier. If your business profile has secondary authorized users, managers, or employee credit cardholders, their view is restricted exclusively to the specific business accounts authorized by the administrator. Secondary users will never see your linked personal accounts.

### Why did my business account disappear right after updating the Chase app?
When the Chase app updates from the App Store or Google Play Store, stored biometrics (Face ID/Fingerprint) can occasionally authenticate using a cached legacy personal profile token instead of your business profile. Log out completely, manually type your Business User ID and Password, and re-enable biometrics.

### Can I separate business and personal accounts again after linking them?
Yes. If you decide in the future to separate your personal accounts from your business login (for example, if you sell the business or bring on outside partners), call Chase Business Direct at 1-877-242-7372 and request a **"Single Sign-On Profile De-linking."** An agent will restore your standalone personal User ID within 24 to 48 hours.
